title: THIS ⚠️ is why day traders LOSE money
summary: Trading educator argues beginners fail by not copying what profitable traders do at small scale; pitches a strategy PDF and trial while warning to learn only from verified-profitable traders.

assertions.quote: they're trading with tiny size but then what they're trying to do is they're trying to predict huge moves in the underlying stock

verdicts.note: Position sizing matters, but both approaches lose for most retail traders.

assertions.quote: learn a strategy that is proven profitable by someone else even if there's no guarantee it'll work for you

verdicts.note: A small minority of experienced day traders are consistently profitable; strategy alone does not make most succeed.
Profitable traders with more than 40 days of experience in the prior year do earn more than their trading costs, but such predictably profitable traders are under 3% of day traders.
Only 3.0% of persistent day traders were net profitable, 1.1% beat minimum wage and 0.5% a bank teller's wage, with no evidence of improvement with experience.
